name: Jellyfin
description: Media server for your movies, TV and music, with apps for TVs and phones.
compose:
services:
  jellyfin:
    image: jellyfin/jellyfin:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: host
    volumes:
      - ./config:/config
      - ./cache:/cache
      - ${SHARE:video}:/media/video:ro
      - ${SHARE:music}:/media/music:ro
